outputs.explanation: Scatter plot showing individual samples (n=141) directly as markers, with marginal histograms; individual data points are the plot itself.
Scatter plot of mean ± s.d. per cell line; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
Line/density (normal distribution) curves representing subtype averages; line plots are exempt from needing individual data points overlaid.
Box plots of ridge lengths per cell line have individual data points (colored dots) overlaid on the boxes.
Polar histograms show binned distributions of phase differences; histograms of this kind are not required to show individual points.
Polar histogram averaged across subtypes; histogram-type plot exempt from needing individual points.
A single example trace with fitted curve for illustration of the fitting method, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual replicate overlay.
Scatter plot of fitted amplitude vs decay rate per sample with error bars reflecting fit uncertainty; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
